paragraphs.text: On the seaside between Judea and Caldea was a wilderness, by which he means Caldea.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, the ruin of Babylon by the Medes and Persians.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: The Assyrians and Chaldeans who had destroyed other nations will be overcome by the Medes and Persians: and this he prophesied a hundred years before it came to pass.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: By Elam he means the Persians.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Because they will find no comfort, they will mourn no more, or I have caused them to cease mourning, whom Babylon had afflicted.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: This the prophet speaks in the person of the Babylonians.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: He prophecies the death of Belshazzar as in Dan 5:30 who in the midst of his pleasures was destroyed.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: of my pleasure hath he turned

paragraphs.text: While they are eating and drinking, they will be commanded to run to their weapons.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: That is, in a vision by the spirit of prophecy.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Meaning, chariots of men of war, and others that carried the baggage.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Meaning, Darius who overcame Babylon.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: The watchman whom Isaiah set up, told him who came toward Babylon, and the angel declared that it would be destroyed: all this was done in a vision.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Meaning, Babylon.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: Which was a city of the Ishmaelites and was so named by Dumah, Ge 25:14.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: A mountain of the Idumeans.
paragraphs.label: p

paragraphs.text: He describes the unquietness of the people of Dumah, who were night and day in fear of their enemies, and ever ran to and fro to enquire news.
paragraphs.label: q

paragraphs.text: For fear, the Arabians will flee into the woods and he appoints the way they will take.
paragraphs.label: r
paragraphs.anchor: the forest in Arabia shall ye

paragraphs.text: Signifying that for fear they will not tarry to eat or drink.
paragraphs.label: s
paragraphs.anchor: water to him that was thirsty

paragraphs.text: He appoints them respite for one year only, and then they would be destroyed.
paragraphs.label: t
paragraphs.anchor: according to the years of an

paragraphs.text: Read Isa 16:14.
paragraphs.label: u

paragraphs.text: Which was the name of a people of Arabia: and by the horrible destruction of all these nations, he teaches the Jews that there is no place for refuge or to escape God's wrath, but only to remain in his Church, and to live in his fear.
paragraphs.label: x
